name: Gutmann Restaurant
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Gutmann Restaurant in Tirol!** Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy, rustic-charm restaurant invites you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, and succulent **Schweinsbraten**—all crafted with local ingredients. Located near **Innsbruck**, we offer breathtaking mountain views and a warm atmosphere. Whether you're exploring the **Zillertal**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or simply unwinding after a day of adventure, our menu promises a taste of **Tirol’s** finest flavors. Come experience **Gemütlichkeit** at its best—where every meal feels like a homecoming. --- **

Our Highlights

** - **Tiroler Spezialitäten** – From **Obatzda** to **Kaspressknödel** - **Fresh mountain cuisine** – Wild game, **Speckknödel**, and seasonal delicacies - **Kinderfreundlich** – A welcoming space for families - **Traditional music & stories** – Live **Jodler** and alpine tales by the fireplace --- **
